text:
We are going to play a magic number game, you may want a pen and paper to write down the numbers as we go.

Think of a number.

Multiply it by 2.

Add 4.

Divide it by 2.

Subtract the number you originally thought of.

Your answer is 2.

Can you figure out why this always works? Can you use counters and cubes (or anything similar you have at home) to show how it works, e.g. use a counter to represent the number you thought of and cube to represent the things you add.
